cases.sentence: Но когда они пришли, то увидели, что ___ уже отвален, а он был очень большим.
cases.translation: But when they arrived, they saw that the stone had already been rolled away, and it was very large.
cases.explain: Камень is the subject of the passive predicate был отвален (had been rolled away), so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: «Кто же откатит нам камень от ___ в гробницу?»
cases.translation: "Who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance to the tomb?"
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) takes the genitive → входа.

cases.sentence: Рано утром, в первый день недели, едва лишь взошло солнце, они пришли к ___.
cases.translation: Early in the morning, on the first day of the week, just as the sun had risen, they came to the tomb.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative → гробнице.

cases.sentence: Они вошли в гробницу и увидели ___, одетого в белое.
cases.translation: They entered the tomb and saw a young man dressed in white.
cases.explain: Юношу is the direct object of увидели (saw) → accusative. Юноша is animate and ends in -а, so it declines like a feminine noun.

cases.sentence: И повсюду проповедовали, и Господь содействовал им, подтверждая их слово ___.
cases.translation: And they preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them, confirming their word with signs.
cases.explain: The instrumental marks the means by which the word was confirmed — "by signs" → знамениями (instrumental plural of знамение).

cases.sentence: Потом Иисус явился в другом ___ двоим из них, когда они шли из города.
cases.translation: Afterward Jesus appeared in another form to two of them as they were walking from the city.
cases.explain: В (in) here marks the manner/state "in another form", which takes the prepositional → облике.

reading.ru: Не бойтесь, вы ищете распятого Иисуса из Назарета? Он воскрес.
reading.question: What did the young man in the tomb tell the frightened women?
options: That Jesus had risen and was not there
That the tomb had been robbed
That they should wait for Peter
That Jesus had gone to Rome
reading.correct: That Jesus had risen and was not there
reading.explain: The young man told them not to be afraid, that Jesus of Nazareth had risen and was not there.

reading.ru: Женщины вышли и побежали от гробницы, испуганные и изумленные.
reading.question: How did the women react after hearing the news at the tomb?
options: They fled in fear and amazement
They argued with the young man
reading.correct: They fled in fear and amazement
reading.explain: The women went out and fled from the tomb, frightened and amazed.

reading.ru: Позже Иисус явился одиннадцати ученикам, когда те возлежали за столом. Он упрекнул их за неверие и упрямство
reading.question: What did Jesus do when he appeared to the eleven disciples at the table?
options: He rebuked them for their unbelief and stubbornness
He asked them to prepare a meal
He sent them away in silence
reading.correct: He rebuked them for their unbelief and stubbornness
reading.explain: Jesus appeared to the eleven at the table and rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart.

reading.ru: Идите по всему миру и возвещайте радостную весть всем людям.
reading.question: What command did Jesus give the disciples?
options: Go into all the world and preach the good news to everyone
reading.correct: Go into all the world and preach the good news to everyone
reading.explain: Jesus told them, "Go into all the world and proclaim the good news to all people."

reading.ru: Он вознесся на небеса и сел по правую руку от Бога.
reading.question: What happened to Jesus after he spoke to the disciples?
options: He was taken up into heaven and sat at the right hand of God
He returned to Galilee to live
He remained with the disciples forty more days
He appeared to the Roman soldiers
reading.correct: He was taken up into heaven and sat at the right hand of God
reading.explain: After speaking to them, Jesus was taken up into heaven and sat at the right hand of God.
